overview: Armor covers 6 body slots — Head, Face, Torso, Legs, Hands and Feet — and its core attributes are Max HP, Damage Reduction, Pollution Resistance and Psi Intensity, on top of a Durability stat that depletes as you take damage (an armor piece breaks and becomes unusable at 0 Durability, though it can be repaired). Wearing multiple pieces from the same named Armor Set grants stacking set bonuses at each piece-count threshold (1/2/3/4, sometimes fewer) — you only get as many thresholds as pieces you have equipped from that set, and you can mix sets to blend partial bonuses from two different sets. Once Human's full armor catalog spans 159 pieces across 20 named sets (per oncehumandb.com).

attributes.name: Max HP
attributes.description: Flat or percentage increase to maximum health; scales with rarity and using higher-rarity hides as crafting materials.

attributes.name: Damage Reduction
attributes.description: Percentage reduction to incoming damage; also scales with hide rarity used in crafting.

attributes.name: Pollution Resistance
attributes.description: Reduces the rate you accumulate Pollution/Mental Pollution in irradiated or RaidZone areas.

attributes.name: Psi Intensity
attributes.description: Boosts status-effect (Frost/Burn/Shock etc.) potency for the wearer.

attributes.name: Durability
attributes.description: Depletes as the piece absorbs damage; upgradeable via the Gear Workbench: Customization tech node for +30% Max Durability. Reaches 0 → the piece breaks until repaired.

craftingNote: Armor is crafted at the same Gear Workbench tiers as weapons (see the Stations section) using hides, fabrics and other materials — higher-rarity hides yield better HP/Damage Reduction rolls on the finished piece.
setBonusMechanic: Set bonuses unlock cumulatively per piece equipped from that set (not a single 2/4/6 breakpoint) — most sets show a distinct effect at 1, 2, 3 and 4 pieces equipped, with the 3rd and 4th piece bonuses usually being the build-defining ones.

bonusesByPiece.effect: When HP is above 70%, Weapon DMG +10%.
Stay crouched and immobile for 0.5s to enter the Bastille state — Weapon DMG +40% while active. After exiting, sprint is disabled and Stamina consumption +100% for 3s.
3s after exiting Bastille state, gain 1 stack of Armor per second (up to 60). Each stack of Armor grants a Shield equal to 1% of max HP while in the Bastille state.
Killing an enemy grants Movement Speed +20% for 2s and Elemental DMG +40%, decaying over 8s.
Each enemy within 5m grants DMG Reduction +4%, stacking up to 4 times.
Every 4 Crit shots land grants 1 stack of Lone Shadow (Crit DMG +6% for 20s, up to 8 stacks).
Increases max Lone Shadow stacks to 10. After reloading, Crit Rate +10% for 2s.
Hitting the same enemy consecutively grants 1 stack of Archer's Focus (Weakspot DMG +4%, up to 10 stacks; halved on switching targets).
Reloading loads an extra 0.6% ammunition per 1% of the previous magazine's shots that hit a weakspot, up to +30%.
While shielded, Weapon DMG and Status DMG +10%.
Consumes 6% of current HP on hit to generate a temporary shield worth 6% of Max HP for 30s (0.5s cooldown; doesn't trigger above 60% Shield).
Automatically uses the lowest-grade Treatment item in your backpack when HP drops below 30% (40s cooldown).

sets.name: Stormweaver Set

bonusesByPiece.effect: Taking damage grants a stack of Powered Armor (DMG Reduction +4% for 10s, up to 6 stacks).
Rolling consumes 3 Powered Armor stacks to trigger a knockback explosion; each enemy hit restores HP +5%, up to 20% (10s cooldown).

sets.playstyle: Damage mitigation with an offensive panic button.

bonusesByPiece.effect: Precise kills grant Bullet Saver (Weakspot DMG +15% for 8s, up to 3 stacks).
Killing an enemy grants Reload Efficiency +20% (plus Fire Rate +10% on a Weakspot kill) until you next reload.
Dealing Elemental DMG grants a stack of Warm Sensation (Elemental DMG +2% for 2s; triggers once per 0.5s, up to 5 stacks).
Between 10°C and 30°C ambient temperature, gain the Warm status: Elemental DMG +18%.
At 5 Warm Sensation stacks you're considered Warm; between 10°C and 30°C, gain an extra Elemental DMG +7%.
